items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: And one of them is Joe Oliver or Lewis Armstrong. Which one of them is playing?

ctx.x: Oh yeah, Crank Bay. Yeah. Crank, something like that.

They want us to get together. And as soon as he can get straight, we going on with him. We ain't gonna take nothing but an old set up. The old style of band. The old set up. Well, if we going on with him, if he falls, we fall too. That's what we figured. If he make it, we make it. And if he don't, well, none of us make it. That's our idea, going along with him. Because he got confidence in us. It's one thing anywhere he put us, we gonna wait. And if it's money there, he'll get it. Because we can wait. If we live,…
What about these dance orchestras? Did you play with any of the earlier dance orchestras, Mr. Robinson?
